allowed: online accepted-prefix first-hit and censoring descriptions for named factor streams
law-by-side contrasts only when the frozen region and finite support overlap are reported
generator attempt/rejection/exhaustion and generator-versus-validation cost accounting
replication labels across the two independent confirmation seeds
failed_or_deferred: no-hit streams remain right-censored rather than zero-probability claims
pilot-only regions with no confirmation event are pilot-view artifacts
small stratum counts are descriptive and not asymptotic inference
prohibited: universal geometric extremes or population-support probabilities
ranking laws by one aggregate rare-hit score
pooling side counts, facet counts, or law knobs
target/sys/capacity transfer, mechanism, or online sampler promotion
using confirmation rows to invent or retune regions

protocol.censoring: first_hit_index is right-censored at accepted-prefix exhaustion when no event appears
protocol.cost_contract: generator_ms comes from producer reports; validation_ms_estimate is Python parse/view cost and is kept separate
protocol.quantile_regions: fixed pooled-pilot lower/upper 0.10 cells, with ties included
protocol.selection_boundary: all region thresholds and support-frontier distances are computed from pilot rows only; confirmation rows are consumed in original producer file order
protocol.uncertainty: Wilson 95% intervals for finite stream event indicators; rows are not IID claims

views.central_symmetry_residual: mean absolute half-period support mismatch divided by mean support
views.support_novelty_distance: minimum circular-shift L2 distance of mean-normalized supports to pooled pilot support set
views.support_roughness: standard deviation of 64-grid support second differences divided by mean support
